```{python}
import _lib as L
import itables
itables.init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=False, connected=True)

HIDE = ["lematy", "cls", "n_mat_kontrast", "n_klas_cel", "rozproszenie", "termopl_ok", "kategoria_final", "model_sedzia",
        "udzial_nazw_wlasnych", "ll_vs_kwjp", "log_ratio_kwjp", "freq_kwjp", "zipf_wordfreq", "duplikat_formy", "typ_szumu",
        "pelny_termin", "warstwa", "kand_przedmiotowy", "kand_ogolny", "etykieta_regulowa", "forma_kandydata", "warianty",
        "freq_kontrast_laczna", "srebrny_pojecie_ref"]
pp, po, poj = L.csv("pula_przedmiotowa.csv"), L.csv("pula_ogolna.csv"), L.csv("pojecia.csv")
hide = lambda df: [c for c in df.columns if c.startswith("rank_") or c.endswith(("_pewnosc", "_uzasadnienie", "_kategoria")) or c in HIDE]
n = lambda v: L.fmt(int(v))
by_freq = lambda df: [[list(df.columns).index("freq_cel"), "desc"]]
extra_path = L.OUT / "terminy_llm_spoza_kandydatow.csv"
```

```{python}
L.table([
    ("Subject pool", "candidates labelled T3 (biology term)", f"{n(len(pp))}, of which {n((pp['dlugosc'] > 1).sum())} multiword"),
    ("General pool", "candidates labelled T1 (everyday) or T2 (school vocabulary)",
     f"{n(len(po))}: {n((po['kategoria'] == 'T1').sum())} T1, {n((po['kategoria'] == 'T2').sum())} T2"),
    ("Matching", "one general word per term: same part of speech, closest in general frequency and length",
     f"{n(pp['dopasowanie_ogolne'].notna().sum())} terms have a partner"),
    ("Concepts", "terms that name the same thing (variants, synonyms, a noun and its adjective)",
     f"{n(len(poj))}, of which {n((poj['n_terminow'] > 1).sum())} group several terms"),
], ["", "What", "In this run"], "lll")
```

How the pools are built: [Method](method.qmd#pools). Labels come from language models; rows with `do_przegladu` =
`True` had no majority. Filter with the boxes under the header, click a header to sort, **Columns** shows hidden columns.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Subject pool (T3)

```{python}
L.source("pula_przedmiotowa.csv")
L.glossary(pp.columns)
L.dt(pp, order=by_freq(pp), hide=hide(pp), wrap=["pojecie"])
```

## General pool (T1/T2)

```{python}
L.source("pula_ogolna.csv")
L.glossary(po.columns)
L.dt(po, order=by_freq(po), hide=hide(po))
```

## Concepts

```{python}
L.source("pojecia.csv")
L.glossary(poj.columns)
L.dt(poj, order=[[list(poj.columns).index("n_terminow"), "desc"]], wrap=["terminy", "pojecie", "dopasowanie_ogolne"])
```

## Terms the extraction missed

```{python}
if extra_path.exists():
    ex = L.csv("terminy_llm_spoza_kandydatow.csv")
    L.md(f"{n(len(ex))} terms that a model listed directly from the materials and that are **not** among the candidates of step 4: "
         "too rare in the sample, or not matching the phrase patterns. They are not in the pools.")
    L.source("terminy_llm_spoza_kandydatow.csv")
    L.glossary(ex.columns)
    L.dt(ex, order=[[list(ex.columns).index("n_materialow"), "desc"]])
else:
    L.md("Direct extraction by a language model was not run.")
```
